Despite these headwinds, the market has beaten the stock down to a distressed 16% of its 52-week range [E5] and a minuscule market capitalisation of ₹ 78.4 Cr [E3], creating an extreme disconnect from its robust intrinsic asset backing. Furthermore, management generates a superior return on assets of 4.78%, easily outperforming the sector benchmark of 1.79% [E8].
